title: Convergence of squared L^2 norms under L^2 convergence
statement: Let (alpha, mu) be a measure space and E a normed additive commutative group. Let f : alpha -> E satisfy MemLp f 2 mu, and let phi_j : alpha -> E (j in N) be mu-a.e. strongly measurable with int ‖phi_j - f‖ₑ^2 dmu -> 0 in [0, infinity]. Then int ‖phi_j‖ₑ^2 dmu -> int ‖f‖ₑ^2 dmu in [0, infinity] (all integrals are lintegrals).
lean_statement: ∀ {α : Type} [MeasurableSpace α] {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] (μ : Measure α) (f : α → E) (φ : ℕ → α → E), MemLp f 2 μ → (∀ j, AEStronglyMeasurable (φ j) μ) → Tendsto (fun j => ∫⁻ x, ‖φ j x - f x‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun j => ∫⁻ x, ‖φ j x‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫⁻ x, ‖f x‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂μ))
